get.description:
**WebSocket endpoint - NOT usable from OpenAPI/Swagger "Try it out".** OpenAPI cannot model
WebSocket connections or the frame protocol (binary chunk frames: 4 byte upload id + payload,
plus JSON control messages), so this entry is documentation only. Connect with a WebSocket
client (`ws://` / `wss://`) and see docs/prd/websocket-file-upload.md for the protocol.
Only registered when WS_UPLOAD_ENABLED=true.
Auth uses the short-lived WS access token from `POST /storages/ws-token` (not the normal session
token): `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header, or `?token=` query for browsers.
Close codes: 4401 session revoked / refresh token reused, 4408 access token expired and not renewed.
